CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 09 / 12

Unit taxes and incidence

Tax equilibrium稅後均衡

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Solve for the buyer's price Pb, seller's net price Ps, and quantity using Pb − Ps = tax, Qd(Pb) = Qs(Ps).

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

需求用買方價 Pb，供給用賣方淨價 Ps，再聯立 Pb−Ps=t。不可在原供需兩式都用同一價格而漏掉稅楔。

Use separate price variables: demand depends on Pb and supply on Ps. Solve Qd(Pb)=Qs(Ps) together with Pb−Ps=t. Substituting a single price into both original curves without the wedge loses the tax.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Qs=2Ps, Qd=300−Pb, t=30. Pb=Ps+30 gives 2Ps=270−Ps; Ps=90, Pb=120, Q=180.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Qs=Ps, Qd=100−Pb and t=20. Seller price? 賣方淨價？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
